title: Favorite trombonists Harrison Bradley and Boots Young
summary: He took up trombone after seeing players, names Harrison Bradley and Albert 'Boots' Young as favorites, and says he sounds like Bradley and subbed for him in Kid Rena's band.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
